note.after_visit_summary: Today we discussed your health and your goal to quit smoking. You feel well with no new symptoms. You smoke about a pack a day and have tried quitting before. Your blood pressure is 132/82, pulse 78, and weight 205 lbs. Your heart, lungs, and abdomen exam were normal. We set your quit date for November 1st. On that day, start the 21 mg nicotine patch each day and use 2 mg nicotine gum when you have cravings. Keep gum in your car to help with urges while driving. Throw away lighters and ashtrays. You can call 1-800-Quit Now for free support. We also ordered a colonoscopy referral because you are 52, and a yearly lung cancer CT scan due to your smoking history. Labs for cholesterol and diabetes were ordered. You received a flu shot in your left arm today. Return in one month to check on your quit progress and review your lab results. Keep up the great work—quitting smoking is the best thing you can do for your health.
